task_instruction: Rewrite each direct yes/no question as a reported question.
paragraphs: Nora is at a hospital for a planned operation. Before the procedure, nurse Patel checks that Nora has had time to speak with the surgical team. Patel asked Nora, {{red:Have you spoken with the surgeon today?}} {{mask_1}} Nora said yes. Patel asked Nora, {{red:Do you understand why the operation is planned?}} {{mask_2}} Nora said that the surgeon had explained it. Patel then asked Nora, {{red:Would you like us to go over any information again?}} {{mask_3}}

The surgeon, Dr. Chen, joins them to review the consent form. Dr. Chen asked Nora, {{red:Have you read the consent form?}} {{mask_4}} Nora said she had read it the night before. Dr. Chen asked Nora, {{red:Do you have any questions about the procedure?}} {{mask_5}} Nora wanted to ask about the expected schedule. Dr. Chen asked Nora, {{red:Can I explain what usually happens before you go to the operating room?}} {{mask_6}}

Nurse Patel confirms some routine details for the care team. Patel asked Nora, {{red:Are you taking any medicines at the moment?}} {{mask_7}} Nora listed the medicines she uses. Patel asked Nora, {{red:Have you told the team about any allergies?}} {{mask_8}} Nora said she had mentioned a medicine allergy. Patel asked Nora, {{red:Do you have your identification band?}} {{mask_9}} Nora showed it to her.

Dr. Chen returns to discuss the recovery area and answer Nora's questions. The doctor asked Nora, {{red:Would you like a family member to receive an update?}} {{mask_10}} Nora said yes. Dr. Chen asked Nora, {{red:Will someone be able to take you home when you are ready to leave?}} {{mask_11}} Nora said that her sister would come. The doctor asked Nora, {{red:Do you know whom to contact if you have questions after discharge?}} {{mask_12}} Nora said she had the hospital's contact information.

Before Nora leaves for the preparation area, nurse Patel reviews the plan once more. Patel asked Nora, {{red:Are you comfortable proceeding today?}} {{mask_13}} Nora said she wanted to ask one final question. Patel asked Nora, {{red:Would you like the surgeon to speak with you again?}} {{mask_14}} Nora said yes, and Dr. Chen returned. The surgeon asked Nora, {{red:Have we answered your questions?}} {{mask_15}} Nora said that the team had answered them.

After the conversation, Nora's sister calls the hospital desk. The receptionist asked Nora's sister, {{red:Are you Nora's contact person?}} {{mask_16}} She confirmed that she was. The receptionist asked Nora's sister, {{red:Would you like me to confirm that the team received your phone number?}} {{mask_17}} She said yes. Later, nurse Patel asked Nora, {{red:Do you feel ready to meet the care team?}} {{mask_18}} Nora said she did. Patel asked Nora, {{red:Can I answer anything else before we begin the preparation steps?}} {{mask_19}} Nora said no. Dr. Chen asked Nora one last time, {{red:Do you understand that you can ask the team questions at any point?}} {{mask_20}} Nora said she understood.
